faq.description: Find quick answers to common questions about our services.
faq.contactDescription: Visit our service center or reach out to us. We're here to help with all your car service needs.

items.question: How does doorstep car service work?
items.answer: Simply book a service through our app or website. Our mechanic will arrive at your location with all tools and equipment. After service completion, pay online or cash.

items.question: What warranty do you provide?
items.answer: We provide 6-month/10,000 km warranty on all services and parts. Any defects in workmanship or parts are fixed free of charge.

items.question: Are your mechanics certified?
items.answer: Yes! All mechanics are trained and certified with 5+ years average experience. They undergo background checks and continuous training.

items.question: Do you use genuine spare parts?
items.answer: We source parts directly from authorized dealers and OEM suppliers. Every part comes with documentation and warranty.

items.question: Can I track my service in real-time?
items.answer: Yes! Get real-time updates with photos and videos of service progress. Chat directly with your mechanic through our app.

items.question: How much can I save compared to authorized centers?
items.answer: Save 30-40% on average compared to authorized service centers while maintaining the same quality standards.
